randomness.azimuth_sampling: four distinct integer degrees in [0,359], deterministic per tile

storage.quantity_description: Sionna path_gain in dB; float16 with NaN for indoor or unhit outdoor pixels

provenance.tile_population: all 27360 physical tile directories tile_000001 through tile_027360
provenance.split_population: existing spatially isolated split: train 21789, val 2840, test 2731
provenance.frequency_note: 3.5 GHz selected by the project instead of the paper's 3.66 GHz.
provenance.paper_parameters_retained: 512 m area, 4 m cells, 128x128, depth 8, 7M rays, reflection and diffraction, BS=max building+5 m, UE=2 m, VH/VH, one isotropic plus four random-azimuth directional maps.
provenance.downtilt_note: A fixed 10 degree downtilt follows the paper's Sionna example in Figure 1(d). The earlier zero-downtilt v1 made high-BS directional maps saturate at the 30 dB cap and was rejected by the pilot.
provenance.implementation_note: The 30 dB directional attenuation cap is an explicit project assumption. Current Sionna RadioMap diffraction is not numerically equivalent to WinProp IRT.
